subject: Collections: Zephyr Analytics overdue invoices & proposed split-payment
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Zephyr — overdue INV-2027-1534 (VAT split question)

Folks,

Quick flag: Zephyr Analytics (PO on file) is showing an outstanding balance of EUR 142,680 across two invoices (INV-2027-1534 and INV-2027-1590). The ledger shows a 90+ day aging for INV-2027-1534 (the larger one) — VAT component ~EUR 22,500.

I've attached the invoice, dunning history, and the original order. Treasury says they have not received any payment proposals in the last 30 days. CS (Evelyn) has been doing the running preview with the customer but they are citing an EU entity reissue/VAT registration problem — requesting split invoices to their Irish subsidiary.

My recommendation: ask for short-term commitment (partial payment within 7 days) and a signed payment plan for the balance. If we can't get a commitment, we should move to a throttled servicing posture and consider routing to external collections. Before we do anything that impacts service, want an aligned decision from Legal/Finance/Sales.

Attachments: Invoice_INV-2027-1534.pdf; Dunning_History_Zephyr.csv

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Finance Lead — Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@zephyr.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 10:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Zephyr — overdue INV-2027-1534 (VAT split question)

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. Following up with the current standing and a proposal so we can close this out without service interruption. Summary: outstanding EUR 142,680 (INV-2027-1534 + INV-2027-1590). We understand you are requesting a VAT reissue to your Irish entity and that part of the delay is internal approvals on your side.

Proposed short-term plan so we can keep the platform fully available:
- Immediate partial payment: EUR 50,000 by Friday 20 Jul 2028.
- Remaining balance: split into two equal installments, EUR 46,340 each, due 30 and 60 days after receipt of the first payment.
- We will reissue a VAT-compliant invoice to your Irish subsidiary upon receipt of the signed Payment Agreement (attached).

Please review, sign the attached PaymentAgreement_Zephyr_0725.pdf and confirm the wiring details. If we receive the signed agreement and the first remittance by end of day Friday we will waive the late fee for this instance and avoid any throttling of API throughput while the schedule is in effect. If we do not receive the commitment, we will begin escalation (service throttling notice + 14-day collections handoff).

Attachment: PaymentAgreement_Zephyr_0725.pdf

Thanks — I want to keep Zephyr as an active customer but need a commitment so Finance can close the aging. If anyone on this thread objects to the proposed waive/waiver approach, please call it out and we can adjust.

Best,

Sofia Ivanova
Senior Account Manager — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Mobile: +44 7700 555 118

--

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@zephyr.ai>

Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Jul 2028 16:08:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Zephyr — overdue INV-2027-1534 (VAT split question)

Hi Sofia —

Appreciate the concise proposal and the willingness to reissue to our Irish entity. Cashflow is tight at month-end due to a delayed receivable; we can do an initial payment this Friday but need the VAT invoice split before we complete the wire. Two quick asks:

1) Can you reissue INV-2027-1534 with the Irish VAT number (IE1234567A) and the billing address for Zephyr Analytics Ireland Ltd?
2) Can you confirm the bank details to use for the EUR transfer and include the payment reference we should quote so Treasury can match it?

We can commit to EUR 50,000 on Friday once the reissued invoice and bank details are visible. After that we will follow the two-installment approach you proposed. If you need a countersigned agreement rather than a signature via email we can route through DocuSign — whichever is faster.

Regards,

Liam O'Connor
Head of Finance
Zephyr Analytics
liam.oconnor@zephyr.ai | +353 87 555 2233

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Executive checkpoint — Zephyr payment commitment and waiver request

Team,

Status update: Liam confirmed verbally today they will remit EUR 50,000 this Friday contingent on our reissued VAT invoice and clear bank details. He asked for DocuSign if we prefer that channel.

Decision request (short window):
1) Approve waiver of the standard late fee for this invoice (one-time exception) if they complete the signed payment agreement and first wire within the stated timeline.
2) Approve reissuing INV-2027-1534 to Zephyr Analytics Ireland Ltd (IE1234567A) and confirming bank details in the Payment Agreement.
3) If the customer fails to pay by 7 days after agreed date, authorize me to issue a Service Throttle Notice and hand the matter to Cascade Collections.

Rationale: keeping service live protects the expansion opportunity (product pilots scheduled Aug–Sep). Waiving the late fee is a small revenue concession relative to churn risk; we should prefer a signed payment plan + commitment. If Legal needs different language in the agreement, Kimberly please advise and I will update before sending to DocuSign.

If I don't hear objections by EOD tomorrow I will proceed with the reissue and DocuSign flow.

Thanks,

Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Account Manager — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
